questions.question: After how long did Lord Brahma say he had come to know about the Lord?
questions.explanation: "O my Lord, today, after many, many years of penance, I have come to know about You." (SB 3.9.1)

questions.question: Brahma said the Lord's form is eternally freed from material contamination and has advented to show mercy to the devotees as a manifestation of what?
questions.explanation: "The form which I see is eternally freed from material contamination and has advented to show mercy to the devotees as a manifestation of internal potency." (SB 3.9.2)

questions.question: Why does Brahma surrender unto the Lord, who is the cause of the cosmic manifestation?

options.text: Because the Lord is untouched by matter
Because the Lord rewards His devotees
Because the Lord controls the demigods

questions.explanation: "I surrender unto You because whereas I am proud of my material body and senses, Your Lordship is the cause of the cosmic manifestation and yet You are untouched by matter." (SB 3.9.3)

questions.question: According to Brahma, who neglect the Lord's personal form because of speculating on material topics?

options.text: Those who are destined to be dispatched to the path of hell

questions.explanation: "Those who are destined to be dispatched to the path of hell neglect Your personal form because of speculating on material topics." (SB 3.9.4)

questions.question: Brahma considers the common people unfortunate because they are bereft of the all-auspicious performance of what?

options.text: Chanting and hearing about the Lord's transcendental activities

questions.explanation: "...persons who are bereft of the all-auspicious performance of chanting and hearing about Your transcendental activities are certainly unfortunate and are also bereft of good sense." (SB 3.9.7)

questions.question: Brahma takes pity on poor creatures who are overwhelmed by which urges, in addition to hunger, thirst and severe cold?

options.text: Strong sex urges and indefatigable anger

questions.explanation: "...and overwhelmed by strong sex urges and indefatigable anger. I take pity on them, and I am very much aggrieved for them." (SB 3.9.8)

questions.question: According to Brahma, even great sages must rotate in this material world if they are against what?
questions.explanation: "Even great sages, if they are against Your transcendental topics, must rotate in this material world." (SB 3.9.10)

questions.question: By what process do the Lord's devotees see Him, so that their hearts become cleansed and He takes His seat there?

options.text: Through the eyes by Deity worship
Through the ears by the process of bona fide hearing

questions.explanation: "O my Lord, Your devotees can see You through the ears by the process of bona fide hearing, and thus their hearts become cleansed, and You take Your seat there." (SB 3.9.11)

questions.question: Brahma said the Lord is not very much satisfied by the worship of whom, who are full of material hankerings?
questions.explanation: "My Lord, You are not very much satisfied by the worship of the demigods, who arrange for Your worship very pompously, with various paraphernalia, but who are full of material hankerings." (SB 3.9.12)

questions.question: Brahma said the tree of planetary systems has grown by first penetrating the material nature in three trunks. Which three?

options.text: Brahma, Siva and the Almighty Lord
Vishnu, Siva and the goddess Kali

questions.explanation: "This tree has grown by first penetrating the material nature in three trunks -- as me, Siva and You, the Almighty -- for creation, maintenance and dissolution..." (SB 3.9.16)

questions.question: To whom does Brahma offer obeisances after stating that the foolish work of people will be cut to pieces?

options.text: Him who acts as eternal time

questions.explanation: "I therefore offer my obeisances unto Him who acts as eternal time." (SB 3.9.17)

questions.question: Brahma said he is situated in an abode which will continue to exist for a time duration of how many parardhas?
questions.explanation: "Although I am situated in an abode which will continue to exist for a time duration of two parardhas..." (SB 3.9.18)

questions.question: While the Lord enjoys the pleasure of sleeping on the bed of snakes in the water of devastation, what is stationed within His abdomen?
questions.explanation: "At that time, all the universal planets are stationed within Your abdomen." (SB 3.9.20)

questions.question: Brahma prays to be empowered, as before, with what, declaring himself one of the surrendered souls dear to the Lord?
questions.explanation: "May He be merciful towards me so that I, as before, may be empowered with the introspection to create..." (SB 3.9.22)

questions.question: The Lord's activities are always enacted through His internal potency, known by what name?

options.text: Rama, or the goddess of fortune

questions.explanation: "His activities are always enacted through His internal potency, Rama, or the goddess of fortune." (SB 3.9.23)

questions.question: After Brahma prayed and became silent, the Lord understood Brahma was anxious about what?

options.text: The planning and construction of the different planetary systems

questions.explanation: "The Lord saw that Brahma was very anxious about the planning and construction of the different planetary systems and was depressed upon seeing the devastating water." (SB 3.9.27-28)

questions.question: The Supreme Personality of Godhead told Brahma not to be depressed or anxious, because what he was begging had been done when?

options.text: It has already been granted before
It will be granted in the next millennium
It is granted at the time of annihilation
It is granted by the demigods

questions.explanation: "What you are begging from Me has already been granted before." (SB 3.9.29)

questions.question: The Lord told Brahma that he would see the Lord in all living entities and over the universe, just as fire is situated where?
questions.explanation: "You will see Me in all living entities as well as all over the universe, just as fire is situated in wood." (SB 3.9.32)

questions.question: The Lord assured Brahma that because his mind is always fixed on Him, which mode will never encroach upon him even while generating progeny?
questions.explanation: "...even though you will be engaged in generating various progeny the vicious mode of passion will never encroach upon you." (SB 3.9.35)

questions.question: After instructing Brahma to expand the creation, in which personal form did the primeval Lord disappear?
questions.explanation: "...the primeval Lord, the Personality of Godhead in His personal form as Narayana, disappeared." (SB 3.9.44)

questions.question: Brahma surrenders unto the Supreme Lord because________.

options.text: Of Lord's Supreme most form of eternal, bliss and knowledge
There is no change or deterioration of Lord's internal potency
Though the cause of cosmic manifestation, Lord is untouched by matter

questions.question: Brahma considers common people unfortunate because________.

options.text: They are bereft of the all auspicious performance of chanting and hearing
They are overwhelmed by strong sex urges and indefatigable anger
They are constantly perplexed by hunger, thirst, severe cold etc

questions.question: The tree of planetary system has grown by first penetrating the material nature as__________.
Brahma is situated in an abode which will continue to exist for a time duration of ______ parardhas.
Lord Brahma is empowered by the introspection of________.
Lord had appeared before Brahma in His personal form as ________ to instruct.
